title: El bautizo
desc: Being asked to be a godparent
setting: Marcos has been circling something for twenty minutes and has now put down his cup.

steps.speaker: Marcos
steps.es: Fijate que te quería preguntar algo.
steps.en: The thing is, I wanted to ask you something.

options.feedback: Two words that open the door without rushing him. That is all he needed.
Fine. Qué pasó suggests something has gone wrong, which is not the tone.
Guessing wrong at the wrong moment, and it says what you assume of him.

steps.speaker: Marcos
steps.es: Queremos que seás el padrino del chavalito.
steps.en: We want you to be the boy's godfather.

options.feedback: No hesitation and no questions first. Anything else in that gap would have been heard.
He has been working up to it for twenty minutes. He is sure.
An honest answer that will land as a no, and he will never ask again.

steps.speaker: Marcos
steps.es: Es un compromiso, vos. No es solo la fiesta.
steps.en: It is a commitment. It is not just the party.

options.es: Ya sé lo que es. Por eso dije que sí.
options.en: I know what it is. That is why I said yes.
options.feedback: You told him you understood the weight and had already accepted it. That is the whole conversation done.
Correct. He was checking, and the check deserved more than agreement.

options.es: ¿Y qué es lo que tengo que hacer?
options.en: And what is it I have to do?
options.feedback: Asked after saying yes, it is fine. Asked here it sounds like you are looking for the size of the bill.

options.es: Compadre, entonces. Se oye raro todavía.
options.en: Compadre, then. It still sounds strange.
options.feedback: You used the word for the first time and admitted it is new. Both things are true and he will like both.
Correct and warm. It says the word without noticing that it changed.
It is not the same as before, and saying so takes something away from him.
